abstract: Yolk sac tumor (YST) is a rare malignancy typically occurring in children. However, bilateral testicular YSTs are a quite rare situation, which can occur metachronously or synchronously with same histologic type, as well as different histology. We present a case of synchronous YST of the left testis and mature teratoma of the right in a 7-month-old infant treated with testis-sparing surgery at right testis and high radical orchiectomy at left. By follow-up of 28th month, no atrophy, or residual tumor in right testis and no recurrence or evidence of disease in left scrotum was found.
abstract_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)は、通常小児に発生する稀な悪性腫瘍である。一方、両側精巣のYSTは極めて稀な病態であり、同一組織型の異時性または同時性の発生のほか、異なる組織型でも生じうる。7か月齢の乳児において、左精巣の同時性YSTと右精巣の成熟奇形腫の症例を経験した。右精巣には精巣温存手術を、左精巣には高位根治的精巣摘除術を施行した。術後28か月の追跡時点で、右精巣に萎縮や残存腫瘍は認められず、左陰嚢に再発や病変の兆候も認められなかった。
